definitions.payment_rate: Bills fully paid by their day-end deadline / bills settled. Undefined before any settlement.
definitions.commitment_fulfillment: Fulfilled non-alliance commitments / accepted commitments due. Undefined when none are due. Offered but unaccepted deals are excluded.
definitions.contribution_gini: Pairwise absolute contribution differences / (2 * actor count * total contribution). Undefined when no contributions occurred.
definitions.goals_met: Actors whose current private cash meets their authored savings target; activity progress is reported separately.
definitions.survival_censored: True unless eviction was observed; reaching the horizon is not an eventual survival time.
definitions.conflicts: Quiet-preferring actor-days disrupted by at least one party.
definitions.conflicts_per_actor_day: Conflict count / (actor count * settled days). Undefined before any settlement; adjusts for different observed survival durations.
definitions.free_rider_candidates: Actor IDs with zero contribution when someone else contributed; a descriptive screening flag, not proof of intentional exploitation.
definitions.actor_action_counts: Action-kind counts per actor in this run segment, excluding inherited branch decisions.
definitions.refusals_after_observed_breach: Reject events after an earlier or same-day breach visible to the rejecting actor; descriptive association, not a causal claim.
definitions.unpaid_bills_followed_by_recovery: Unpaid bills with a later fully paid bill within the observed horizon.
definitions.dominant_action_share: Most frequent action kind / decisions in this run segment. Branches retain world totals but this distribution describes the child segment.
definitions.fallback_rate: Fallback decisions committed in this run segment / decisions committed in this same segment. Inherited branch failures are excluded from both numerator and denominator; undefined for an empty segment.
definitions.accounting_balanced: Initial household cash + automatic income - external expenses equals current household cash. Transfers and lending conserve household cash.
definitions.usage: Actor calls, tokens, known costs, unpriced calls and fallbacks. Evaluator/supervisor jobs have separate artifacts. Unknown prices are never labeled measured zero cost. On branches these counters include inherited usage; do not sum parent and child usage to count physical requests.
definitions.segment_decisions: Number of committed decisions in this run segment, excluding inherited decisions.
definitions.segment_fallbacks: Number of committed decisions in this run segment with a recorded fallback reason.
definitions.inherited_fallbacks: Cumulative checkpoint fallback count minus this segment fallback count. Not a numerator for segment fallback_rate.

limits: Reciprocity, exploitation and information value need paired interventions and event inspection. These counts alone do not measure game-theoretic equilibrium, enjoyment or strategic optimality.
